senses: n. 方位;方向角,方位角
bearing.usage: 串词成句:I can't bear(忍受) your bearing(举止).；索引p403

ex.en: If you've explored the area before, keep an eye out for familiar sights—you may be surprised how quickly identifying a distinctive rock or tree can restore your bearings.
ex.zh: 如果你之前来过这片区域，那么多注意那些熟悉的景象——你可能会惊喜地发现，一块特别的石头或者一棵显眼的树能迅速地帮你找到（原路的）方向。

ex.en: The satellite signal helped the lost hikers get their bearings.
ex.zh: 卫星信号帮助迷路的徒步者辨明了方向。

ex.en: His early travels had a direct bearing on his later novels.
ex.zh: 他早年的旅行经历对他后来的小说创作有直接影响。

senses: n. 凶残的人,举止粗野的人

ex.en: Wolves are not the savage beast of legend but cautious animals that avoid humans.
ex.zh: 狼并非传说中的凶残野兽，而是避开人类的谨慎动物。

senses: v. 敲打；打败；（心脏）跳动
beat.usage: 过去式beat，过去分词beaten。；辨析:beat连续地打;hit侧重击中;strike一般用语;又:beat about for寻找

ex.en: The champion beat her rival in straight sets to retain the title.
ex.zh: 卫冕冠军直落两盘击败对手，保住了冠军头衔。

ex.en: The region's beautiful coastline attracts tourists, but rapid development threatens its fragile ecosystem.
ex.zh: 该地区美丽的海岸线吸引着游客，但快速开发正威胁其脆弱的生态系统。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Volunteers planted flowers along the main street to beautify the aging district.
ex.zh: 志愿者们在主街沿线种花，美化这片老城区。

senses: n. [C] 美人；美好的东西；优点

ex.en: Mathematicians often describe an elegant proof in terms of its beauty.
ex.zh: 数学家常以美感来形容一个优雅的证明。

ex.en: The flight was cancelled because fog had closed the airport for most of the morning.
ex.zh: 由于大雾导致机场关闭了大半个上午，航班被取消了。

senses: v.-link. 开始变得；变成；成为
become.usage: 辨析：become/get 均指感情、身体状况或自然、社会的变化，get 不及 become 正式，正式文体避免使用；go 一般指事物颜色变化或变得不好；turn 正式用语，指颜色、天气或人的行为变化

ex.en: Remote work has become the norm for many office employees since the pandemic.
ex.zh: 疫情以来，远程办公已成为许多上班族的常态。

senses: n. 圃,花坛,河床,矿床,海底

ex.en: The river's bed has narrowed over decades, raising the risk of serious flooding.
ex.zh: 数十年间河床不断变窄，加大了发生严重洪水的风险。

ex.en: Farmers depend on the bee population, since bees pollinate a third of food crops.
ex.zh: 农民依赖蜜蜂种群，因为蜜蜂为三分之一的粮食作物授粉。

ex.en: Consumers are cutting back on beef amid growing concerns about its environmental impact.
ex.zh: 出于对环境影响的日益担忧，消费者正在减少牛肉消费。

ex.en: The brewery stopped bottling beer in glass to cut packaging waste.
ex.zh: 这家啤酒厂停止用玻璃瓶灌装啤酒，以减少包装垃圾。

before.usage: prep.(时间上)在……之前，早 于；当面；在……前面 conj.在……以前；到……为止 adv.以前，已经

ex.en: Wash your hands before you handle any food.
ex.zh: 处理任何食物之前要先洗手。

ex.en: Such rapid technological change has never occurred before.
ex.zh: 以前从未发生过如此迅速的技术变革。

ex.en: She had never seen the sea before she moved to the coastal town.
ex.zh: 搬到这座海滨小镇之前，她从未见过大海。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: vt. （尤指和需要帮助者）做朋友；友善相待
v. 做(尤指需要帮助者)的朋友;友善对待

ex.en: The charity pairs students with elderly residents whom they befriend through weekly visits.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构安排学生与老年居民结对，通过每周探访与他们建立友谊。

senses: vt.&vi. 恳求；祈求；哀求；乞讨

ex.en: Humanitarian agencies beg donors not to forget the crisis once the headlines fade.
ex.zh: 人道主义机构恳求捐赠者不要在新闻热度消退后忘记这场危机。

senses: vi. 起始；开始存在（或进行）
v. 开始,创始,开始讲话

ex.en: The trial will begin once regulators approve the final safety protocol.
ex.zh: 一旦监管机构批准最终的安全方案，试验就将开始。

senses: n. [C-常用 sing.] 开头；开端
beginning.usage: from the beginning 从一开始;at the beginning 最初,起初

ex.en: At the beginning of the century, few predicted the rapid rise of social media.
ex.zh: 在本世纪初，很少有人预见到社交媒体的迅速兴起。

behalf.usage: n.代表；因为，为了……的利益； 就……而言，在……一方；索引p403

ex.en: The lawyer accepted the settlement on behalf of her client.
ex.zh: 律师代表其客户接受了和解协议。

ex.en: The chairman thanked the volunteers on behalf of the entire board.
ex.zh: 主席代表整个董事会向志愿者表示感谢。

ex.en: Local residents signed the petition on behalf of their elderly neighbours.
ex.zh: 当地居民代表年长的邻居在请愿书上签了名。

senses: v. 表现；举止得体；（机器）运转
behave.usage: behavior 行为。；同义:operate(运转)；v.行为，表现；起作用；举止得 体；v.表现例为2018年阅读；索引p403

ex.en: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
ex.zh: 毫无疑问，同龄人对我们的行为会产生巨大的影响。

ex.en: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.
ex.zh: 如果软件能像药品现在能做的那样大规模挽救生命，那大数据就有望像大药厂那样发挥作用。

ex.en: Children learn how to behave in public mainly by observing the adults around them.
ex.zh: 儿童主要是通过观察身边的成人来学习在公共场合如何举止得体。

senses: n. 行为；（科学领域）运动表现

ex.en: The study tracks the behavior of consumers during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 该研究追踪经济低迷期间消费者的行为。

ex.en: His rude behavior at the meeting surprised everyone who knew him.
ex.zh: 他在会上的粗鲁举动让所有认识他的人都感到意外。

ex.en: Parents' own behavior shapes children's attitudes toward money.
ex.zh: 父母自身的行为塑造着孩子对金钱的态度。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

behavioral.usage: adj.行为的，行为研究的；书中亦作behavioural

ex.en: Behavioral economists study why people make irrational financial choices.
ex.zh: 行为经济学家研究人们为何做出非理性的财务决策。

ex.en: The therapy focuses on changing the child's behavioral patterns.
ex.zh: 这种疗法着眼于改变孩子的行为模式。

ex.en: Behavioral differences between the two species reflect their distinct habitats.
ex.zh: 两个物种之间的行为差异反映了它们各自不同的栖息地。

ex.en: The study links aggressive behaviour in teenagers to sleep deprivation.
ex.zh: 这项研究把青少年的攻击性行为与睡眠不足联系起来。

ex.en: Consumers' buying behaviour changes sharply during economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 在经济不确定时期，消费者的购买行为会发生急剧变化。

ex.en: Good behaviour in class is rewarded with extra reading time.
ex.zh: 课堂上表现良好可以获得额外的阅读时间作为奖励。

ex.en: The country lags behind its neighbours in investment in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 该国在可再生能源投资方面落后于邻国。

senses: n. [U] 存在；生存；思想感情

phrases.m: 开始存在,产生,形成,成立

ex.en: Dolphins are highly intelligent beings.
ex.zh: 海豚是非常聪明的生物。

ex.en: Human beings adapt to new environments far faster than most species.
ex.zh: 人类适应新环境的速度远快于大多数物种。

ex.en: The novel imagines beings from a distant planet.
ex.zh: 这部小说想象了来自遥远星球的生命。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

belief.usage: 复数beliefs。；to one's belief 据...看来；n.相信，信心；看法，信念；索引p403

ex.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
ex.zh: 我也不喜欢定额；这种做法和我对任人唯贤的精英管理的信念相悖。

ex.en: It is my firm belief that early education shapes later success.
ex.zh: 我坚信早期教育影响日后的成功。

ex.en: The tribe's traditional beliefs forbid hunting during the spring months.
ex.zh: 该部落的传统信仰禁止在春季狩猎。

ex.en: He acted in the belief that rescue was already on its way.
ex.zh: 他相信救援已经在路上，便采取了行动。

senses: vt. 相信；认为真实；认定
believe.usage: make believe 假装。belief 名词。；关联:believable可信任的;unbelievable不可信的;believer信徒；索引p403

ex.en: Scientists believe the fossils are more than a million years old.
ex.zh: 科学家们认为这些化石已有一百多万年的历史。

ex.en: I find it hard to believe that he completed the project alone.
ex.zh: 我很难相信他是独自完成这个项目的。

ex.en: Most consumers believe that organic food is healthier, though the evidence is mixed.
ex.zh: 大多数消费者相信有机食品更健康，尽管相关证据并不一致。

ex.en: The warning bell sounds automatically whenever smoke is detected in the building.
ex.zh: 一旦大楼内探测到烟雾，警铃就会自动响起。

senses: n. [C] 够填饱肚子的食物
vi. 应在（某处）；适应；合得来
belong.usage: 不用于被动语态和进行时。

ex.en: Most scholars agree that the manuscript belongs to the fifteenth century.
ex.zh: 大多数学者认为这份手稿属于十五世纪。

beloved.usage: 助记:be(是)+loved(被爱)→被爱的人→爱人

ex.en: The beloved novelist, who died last month, donated most of her royalties to rural schools.
ex.zh: 上个月去世的这位深受爱戴的小说家将大部分版税捐给了乡村学校。

below.usage: 助记:be(是)+low(下面)→是在下面→在……下面

ex.en: Temperatures fell below freezing for a week, damaging much of the fruit harvest.
ex.zh: 气温连续一周低于冰点，损坏了大部分水果收成。

belt.usage: n.腰带，皮带 v.用腰带系紧；狠打；抽打

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
ex.zh: 飞机起飞前请系好安全带。

ex.en: The region forms a green belt around the capital.
ex.zh: 该地区构成了环绕首都的绿化带。

ex.en: The factory's conveyor belt stopped, halting production for hours.
ex.zh: 工厂的传送带停了下来，生产中断了数小时。

senses: n. [U] 紧缩预算，省吃俭用
n. 长凳，长椅；法官；法官席位
bench.usage: 他坐在沙滩（beach）上的长凳（bench）上。

ex.en: We sat at either end of a long bench.
ex.zh: 我们坐在一张长凳的两端。

ex.en: Office workers eat lunch on a bench in the park.
ex.zh: 上班族在公园的长凳上吃午饭。

ex.en: The new judge took her seat on the bench last month.
ex.zh: 这位新法官上个月正式就任法官席位。

senses: vt. 以（某事物）为标准评估（某事物）
v. 使弯曲，折弯；使倾斜
bend.usage: b这个字母最后（end）变成了d，不就是“弯曲”的结果吗？；索引p403

ex.en: Bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
ex.zh: 膝盖弯曲，保持背部挺直。

ex.en: The river bends sharply to the east just below the old mill.
ex.zh: 河流在老磨坊下方不远处急剧折向东流。

ex.en: Bend the wire into a circle and fix the ends with tape.
ex.zh: 把铁丝弯成圆圈，用胶带把两端固定住。

ex.en: Drivers are warned to slow down before the dangerous bend.
ex.zh: 司机们被提醒在危险弯道前减速。

ex.en: Beneath the modern city lies a network of tunnels built during the war.
ex.zh: 这座现代城市之下有一个战争时期修建的隧道网络。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. [C] 施主；捐助者；赞助人
n. 施主,捐款人,赞助人
benefactor.usage: 串词记忆：使你受益(benefit)的人就是赞助者(benefactor)；索引p403

ex.en: The new library was built with money from an anonymous benefactor.
ex.zh: 新图书馆是用一位匿名捐助人的捐款建造的。

ex.en: Her benefactor paid her tuition through four years of medical school.
ex.zh: 她的恩人资助了她医学院四年的学费。

ex.en: The gallery's greatest benefactor collected paintings for half a century.
ex.zh: 这家美术馆最大的赞助人收藏绘画长达半个世纪。

beneficial.usage: 辨析:beneficial有益(身心健康等);profitable可赚钱,指经济利益；adj.有益的，有利的；索引p403

ex.en: Regular moderate exercise is highly beneficial to both physical health and mental well-being.
ex.zh: 经常进行适度锻炼对身体健康和心理健康都极为有益。

ex.en: The tax cut proved beneficial to small businesses struggling to survive the recession.
ex.zh: 事实证明，减税对在衰退中挣扎求存的中小企业是有益的。

ex.en: Spending time in nature has a beneficial effect on children's concentration and creativity.
ex.zh: 亲近大自然对儿童的专注力和创造力有积极影响。

benefit.usage: beneficial 有益的。；for the benefit of 为了...的好处或利益；n.好处；救济金 v.使受益；得益于；bene(谐音“逼你”)+fit(合适的，健康的)→逼你变健康，对你有益→有益于；好处；词根记忆：bene(good,好处)+fit(make,使)→使得到好处→好处；索引p403

ex.en: It is not enough to say that the algorithms DeepMind develops will benefit patients and save lives.
ex.zh: 仅仅说 DeepMind（深度思考）开发的算法将使患者受益并挽救生命是不够的。

ex.en: But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
ex.zh: 但大多时候这些政策都是一种虚伪的道德宣扬：只对特权阶级有利，对于大众几乎没有什么帮助。

ex.en: Small firms in remote regions will benefit most from the new high-speed internet project.
ex.zh: 偏远地区的小企业将从新的高速互联网项目中获益最多。

senses: adj. (人或行为)仁慈的,和蔼的
adj. 良性的；无害的；和善的
benign.usage: 派生:benignly adv.良好地,仁慈地；adj.和蔼的；良性的，宜人的；索引p403

ex.en: The tumour proved benign and required no further treatment.
ex.zh: 肿瘤被证明是良性的，无需进一步治疗。

ex.en: The island enjoys a benign climate all year round.
ex.zh: 这座岛屿全年气候温和宜人。

ex.en: Historians now view the empire's early rule as relatively benign.
ex.zh: 历史学家如今认为该帝国早期的统治相对宽厚。

senses: prep. 在旁边（或附近）；与……相比

ex.en: Beside the financial gains, the merger promises access to new technologies.
ex.zh: 除了经济收益之外，此次合并还承诺获得新技术。

besides.usage: besides还包括；except不包括。；辨析：except从整体中除去（不包括在整体内）；besides除去一部分还有一部分（包括在整体内）；beside表示在…旁边；索引p403

ex.en: Besides helping you feel close and connected to people you care about, it turns out that hugs can bring a host of health benefits to your body and mind.
ex.zh: 除了帮助你感受与自己关心的人密不可分之外，拥抱被发现还可以给你的身心带来一系列好处。

ex.en: Besides English, she speaks fluent French and a little Arabic.
ex.zh: 除了英语，她还会讲流利的法语和一点阿拉伯语。

ex.en: The flat is too expensive; besides, it is far from the underground station.
ex.zh: 这套公寓太贵了，而且离地铁站很远。

ex.en: Besides the main course, the banquet included soup, salad and dessert.
ex.zh: 除主菜外，宴会还包括汤、沙拉和甜点。

ex.en: The committee will select the best proposal based on cost, feasibility, and impact.
ex.zh: 委员会将根据成本、可行性和影响选出最佳方案。

ex.en: Her novel about climate migration became an instant bestseller.
ex.zh: 她那部关于气候移民的小说迅速成为畅销书。

ex.en: The company's compact speaker has been a bestseller for three years.
ex.zh: 该公司的紧凑型音箱三年来一直是畅销产品。

ex.en: The bestseller has been translated into more than thirty languages.
ex.zh: 这本畅销书已被翻译成三十多种语言。

bet.usage: You bet.肯定没问题。；v.打赌，赌博；敢肯定 n.下注；赌金

ex.en: Investing in early education is a safe bet for any government.
ex.zh: 对任何政府来说，投资早期教育都是稳妥之举。

ex.en: He bet twenty pounds on the away team to win.
ex.zh: 他押了二十英镑赌客队获胜。

ex.en: The startup is a risky bet, but the potential rewards are huge.
ex.zh: 投资这家初创公司是一场高风险的赌注，但潜在回报巨大。

betray.usage: 派生betrayal背叛,告密;betrayer叛徒,卖国者；发音类似“背捶”→朋友“背叛”了他，他生气地捶他的背→背叛，出卖；索引p403

ex.en: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity.
ex.zh: 编辑《世界新闻报》的目的不是为了提升读者的理解力，也不是在报道中追求公平或者违背任何共有的人性。

ex.en: The officer betrayed his country by selling military secrets to a foreign power.
ex.zh: 这名军官向外国势力出卖军事机密，背叛了自己的国家。

ex.en: His trembling hands betrayed his nervousness during the interview.
ex.zh: 面试时他颤抖的双手暴露了他的紧张。

ex.en: She promised never to betray the trust her supporters had placed in her.
ex.zh: 她承诺决不辜负支持者对她的信任。

ex.en: Early diagnosis allows patients to manage the condition far better and avoid complications.
ex.zh: 早期诊断能让患者更好地控制病情并避免并发症。

between.usage: between在两者之间,among在三者及以上之间;between A,B...and E结构谈精确地理位置时须用between

ex.en: The treaty eased tensions between the two countries after years of border disputes.
ex.zh: 该条约缓解了两国多年边境争端后的紧张关系。

ex.en: Several cities have imposed a tax on sugary beverage sales to curb childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 一些城市已对含糖饮料销售征税，以遏制儿童肥胖。

ex.en: Officials warned consumers to beware of fake online shops during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 官员们提醒消费者在假日季警惕假冒网店。

ex.en: The sheer number of pension options can bewilder even financially literate consumers.
ex.zh: 数量繁多的养老金选择甚至会让有理财知识的消费者感到困惑。

phrases.m: 各种各样令人眼花缭乱的…

senses: prep. 在（或向）……较远的一边；晚于
prep. 在(或向)...的那边,远于

ex.en: The environmental benefits of the policy extend far beyond the capital itself.
ex.zh: 这项政策的环境效益远远超出了首都本身的范围。

bias.usage: [近] prejudice n. 偏见；同义 prejudice，injustice，favor；反义 justice n. 公正；n.偏见；偏好 v.使有偏见，使偏心；索引p403

ex.en: But it never seems to get around to noticing the cultural and class biases that so many former buyers are complaining about.
ex.zh: 但它似乎从来没有注意到许多先前买家抱怨的文化和阶级偏见。

ex.en: It uses analytics to help identify where there may be bias in the hiring process.
ex.zh: 它使用分析工具来帮助鉴别招聘过程中可能存在的偏见。

ex.en: The judge warned the jury not to let personal bias influence their final decision.
ex.zh: 法官警告陪审团不要让个人偏见影响他们的最终裁决。

senses: adj. 有偏见的,倾向性的,片面的;偏重,偏向
biased.usage: adj.有偏见的，偏袒的；偏 重……的；索引p403

ex.en: The professor was accused of being biased against research from smaller universities.
ex.zh: 这位教授被指对规模较小的大学的研究抱有偏见。

ex.en: A biased sample of voters made the opinion poll unreliable.
ex.zh: 带有偏向的选民样本使这次民调不可靠。

ex.en: A fair report presents the facts without biased commentary.
ex.zh: 公正的报道呈现事实时不带偏见评论。

ex.en: Scholars have studied early printed editions of the Bible to trace translation history.
ex.zh: 学者们研究了早期的《圣经》印刷版本，以追溯翻译史。

senses: v./n. 出价；投标；努力争取
bid.usage: 派生 bidder n. 出价者，竞买者；bidding n. 命令，出价；索引p403

ex.en: Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
ex.zh: 家长们会看他们的电子邮件，而孩子们会兴奋地努力争取他们的注意。

ex.en: Parents would be looking at their e-mails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
ex.zh: 父母们在查看电子邮件的时候，孩子们却可能在焦躁不安地企图得到父母的关注。

ex.en: The firm made a hostile bid for its largest rival last month.
ex.zh: 上个月这家公司对其最大对手发起了敌意收购。

ex.en: She bid five hundred dollars for the antique mirror at the auction.
ex.zh: 拍卖会上，她为那面古董镜出价五百美元。

ex.en: One big obstacle to electric cars is the shortage of charging stations.
ex.zh: 电动汽车的一大障碍是充电站的短缺。

bilingual.usage: adj.熟悉两种语言的 n.熟谙两种语言的人

phrases.m: (对重大事故)赔偿和承担责任

bill.usage: 发音类似“币哦”→币就是钱，要花钱的就是“账单”

ex.en: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared.
ex.zh: 更糟的是，养活你自己、养活家人以及支付账单的关键收入已经消失。

ex.en: Parliament rejected the bill after heated debate.
ex.zh: 经过激烈辩论，议会否决了该法案。

ex.en: Households are struggling with rising energy bills this winter.
ex.zh: 今年冬天，许多家庭正在为不断上涨的能源账单发愁。

ex.en: The billboard advertising the new phone towers over the busy intersection.
ex.zh: 宣传新款手机的大型广告牌矗立在繁忙的十字路口。

ex.en: Digital billboards can change their message several times a minute.
ex.zh: 数字广告牌每分钟可以更换数次展示内容。

ex.en: Critics complain that billboards spoil the character of historic streets.
ex.zh: 批评者抱怨广告牌破坏了历史街区的风貌。

ex.en: The government will spend two billion dollars upgrading the aging rail network.
ex.zh: 政府将花费二十亿美元升级老化的铁路网。

senses: n. （储存物品的）箱子；垃圾箱

ex.en: The council introduced separate bins so that households can recycle glass, paper, and plastic.
ex.zh: 市政部门设置了分类垃圾箱，方便家庭回收玻璃、纸张和塑料。

senses: vt. (使)联合在一起；捆绑；约束；装订
bind.usage: 派生binding捆绑;binder夹子,纸夹；索引p403

ex.en: She was bound to a chair.
ex.zh: 她被捆在一把椅子上。

ex.en: Newton's laws of motion and Darwinian evolution each bind a host of different phenomena into a single explicatory framework.
ex.zh: 牛顿的运动定律和达尔文的进化论分别将许多不同的现象归纳得出一个单一的解释性框架。

ex.en: The nurse bound the wound with a clean bandage.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的绷带包扎了伤口。

ex.en: The contract binds both parties to keep the terms secret for five years.
ex.zh: 合同约束双方对条款保密五年。

ex.en: The biographer spent five years interviewing the scientist's colleagues.
ex.zh: 这位传记作者花了五年时间采访这位科学家的同事。

ex.en: A good biographer must balance sympathy with objectivity.
ex.zh: 一位优秀的传记作家必须在同情与客观之间取得平衡。

ex.en: Her biographer revealed how deeply the failure affected the writer.
ex.zh: 她的传记作者揭示了那次失败对这位作家影响之深。

biography.usage: 助记:bio(生命)+graphy(写作)→写人一生的东西→传记；词根记忆: bio(life, 生命)+graph(record, 记录)+y(名词后缀)→一生的记录→传记；索引p403

ex.en: The biography traces the painter's rise from poverty to fame.
ex.zh: 这部传记追溯了这位画家从贫困到成名的历程。

ex.en: He is writing an authorized biography of the former president.
ex.zh: 他正在撰写这位前总统的授权传记。

ex.en: Readers often learn more from a good biography than from a textbook.
ex.zh: 读者从一本好的传记中学到的东西往往比从教科书中学到的更多。

senses: adj. 与生命过程有关的；生物学的

ex.en: Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.
ex.zh: 《加入俱乐部》一书中充斥着太多不相关的细节，对于使同辈压力如此强大的社会和生理因素探讨的也不够。

ex.en: Sleep patterns are governed by biological clocks that respond to light.
ex.zh: 睡眠模式由对光线作出反应的生物钟控制。

ex.en: Adopted children often search for their biological parents.
ex.zh: 被收养的孩子常常会寻找自己的亲生父母。

ex.en: Humans are biologically similar to chimpanzees, sharing almost ninety-nine percent of their DNA.
ex.zh: 人类在生物学上与黑猩猩相似，共享近百分之九十九的 DNA。

ex.en: Marine biologists have recorded a sharp decline in coral reefs worldwide.
ex.zh: 海洋生物学家记录到全世界珊瑚礁急剧减少。

ex.en: The biologist spent a decade studying penguins on the Antarctic coast.
ex.zh: 这位生物学家花了十年时间研究南极海岸的企鹅。

ex.en: As a biologist, she doubts that the species can adapt so quickly.
ex.zh: 作为生物学家，她怀疑该物种能否如此迅速地适应。

biology.usage: 助记:bio(生命)+logy(构词成分,指论或学)→生物学

ex.en: Advances in biology have transformed medicine over the past century.
ex.zh: 过去一个世纪，生物学的进步改变了医学。

ex.en: She studied marine biology at a university on the coast.
ex.zh: 她在沿海的一所大学学习海洋生物学。

ex.en: A basic knowledge of biology helps people evaluate health claims.
ex.zh: 基础的生物学知识有助于人们评估各种健康说法。

senses: n. 生物量（以单位面积或容积表示）

ex.en: Scientists estimate that the total biomass of fish in the lake has fallen by a third over the past decade.
ex.zh: 科学家估计，过去十年里湖中鱼类的总生物量减少了三分之一。

ex.en: The biomedical lab received a large grant to study ageing.
ex.zh: 该生物医学实验室获得了一笔研究衰老问题的大额资助。

ex.en: Biomedical engineering combines medicine with modern technology.
ex.zh: 生物医学工程将医学与现代技术相结合。

ex.en: Ethical review is required for all biomedical research involving humans.
ex.zh: 所有涉及人类的生物医学研究都必须经过伦理审查。

senses: n. [U] 人类亲近大自然的天性

ex.en: The architect designed the office around biophilia, filling it with plants and daylight to improve workers' wellbeing.
ex.zh: 这位建筑师围绕人类亲近自然的天性来设计办公室，用植物和自然光填满空间，以改善员工的身心健康。

ex.en: The city has become a hub for biotech firms developing new treatments for rare diseases.
ex.zh: 这座城市已成为生物技术公司的聚集地，这些公司致力于开发治疗罕见疾病的新疗法。

ex.en: the biotic community // the biotic clock
ex.zh: 生态群落 // 生物钟

ex.en: Scientists study how biotic factors interact with climate in wetlands.
ex.zh: 科学家研究湿地中生物因子与气候如何相互作用。

ex.en: Pollution can severely damage the biotic balance of a lake.
ex.zh: 污染会严重破坏湖泊的生物平衡。

senses: a. 双足行走的；两腿行走的

ex.en: The island's rare birds attract thousands of tourists each spring, boosting the local economy considerably.
ex.zh: 岛上珍稀的鸟类每年春天吸引成千上万的游客，极大地促进了当地经济。

birth.usage: 另 give birth to 出生，产生

ex.en: The birth rate in many developed countries has declined sharply, raising concerns about future labour shortages.
ex.zh: 许多发达国家的出生率急剧下降，引发了对未来劳动力短缺的担忧。

ex.en: She celebrated her ninetieth birthday surrounded by four generations of her family at the village hall.
ex.zh: 她在村礼堂里，在四代家人的陪伴下庆祝了九十岁生日。

senses: n. 因生于某一家庭、国家等而享受的权利
n. 与生俱来的权利(或所有物)

ex.en: The company recalled packets of biscuits after tests revealed they contained an undeclared nut ingredient.
ex.zh: 检测发现饼干中含有未声明的坚果成分后，该公司召回了成包的饼干。

bit.usage: 又:do one's bit尽一点力;every bit完全(一样);派生bitty拼凑的;零碎的

ex.en: The new policy has helped a bit, but unemployment in the region remains stubbornly high.
ex.zh: 新政策有所帮助，但该地区的失业率仍然居高不下。

senses: n. 一口;(表演、文章等的)影响力,感染力,尖锐,犀利

phrases.p: bite off more than one can chew

bite.usage: 又:bite sb.'s head off冲……发脾气;辨析:bite咬叮;gnaw啃;nibble细咬

ex.en: Mosquito bites can transmit serious diseases, so travellers are advised to wear protective clothing at dusk.
ex.zh: 蚊虫叮咬可能传播严重疾病，因此建议旅行者在黄昏时分穿防护衣物。

bitter.usage: 派生bitterly痛苦地,愤恨地;bitterness苦味;辛酸,苦难；索引p403

ex.en: The dispute between the two companies ended in bitter litigation.
ex.zh: 两家公司的争端以激烈的诉讼告终。

ex.en: The medicine left a bitter taste in her mouth.
ex.zh: 这种药在她嘴里留下了苦味。

ex.en: The region's bitter winters make farming difficult.
ex.zh: 该地区严寒的冬季使耕作变得困难。

senses: adj. (指态度、容貌、款式等)奇异的,古怪的
bizarre.usage: 派生bizarrely奇异；adj.奇异的，古怪的；索引p403

ex.en: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
ex.zh: 有段时间托马斯·皮克蒂以及其他经济学家一直在向人们警示不平等现象在加剧,继承财产的影响力愈发膨胀,但离奇的是,这些富有的贵族家庭竟然仍是现代民主国家的象征性核心。

ex.en: The witness gave a bizarre account of the accident that puzzled the police.
ex.zh: 证人对事故作了离奇的陈述，令警方困惑不解。

ex.en: It seems bizarre that such a talented player was ignored for so long.
ex.zh: 如此有天赋的球员竟长期被忽视，这似乎很奇怪。

ex.en: The dress code requires staff to wear black trousers and a white shirt during official events.
ex.zh: 着装规定要求员工在正式活动中穿黑色长裤和白衬衫。

ex.en: Despite the spread of digital screens, many rural schools still rely on the blackboard for daily teaching.
ex.zh: 尽管数字屏幕日益普及，许多乡村学校的日常教学仍然依靠黑板。

senses: n. [C] 铁匠（尤指打马蹄铁者）

ex.en: In the nineteenth century, every village had a blacksmith who made and repaired farm tools.
ex.zh: 在十九世纪，每个村子都有一名打造和修理农具的铁匠。

blade.usage: 助记:音'不累的'→切东西不累→刀刃

ex.en: The knife's blade had grown so dull that it took twice as long to prepare the vegetables.
ex.zh: 刀刃已经变得非常钝，切菜花费了平时两倍的时间。

blame.usage: 助记:着flame(火)是谁的blame(责任);派生blameless无可指责的；v.责怪，归咎于 n.责备，过错，罪责；b(不)+la(拉)+me(我)→跑步时他不拉我一把，我就"责备"他；另:shoulder the blame承担责任;易混:condemn尤指从道义上谴责,blame为普通用词；索引p403

ex.en: A dropped cigarette is being blamed for the fire.
ex.zh: 一根乱扔的烟被认为是这场火灾的肇因。

ex.en: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
ex.zh: 对近期争论的一些责备矛头指向天文学家们。

ex.en: Experts blame the rising obesity rate on cheap processed food and increasingly inactive lifestyles.
ex.zh: 专家将不断上升的肥胖率归咎于廉价的加工食品和越来越缺乏运动的生活方式。

blank.usage: 发音类似“不来客”→我开了一家小面馆，从来没有来过客人，我的小面馆就是“空着的”。

ex.en: Sign your name in the blank space below.
ex.zh: 在下面的空白处签上名字。

ex.en: Candidates must write their answers in the blank space provided.
ex.zh: 考生必须把答案写在提供的空白处。

ex.en: My mind went completely blank when the interviewer asked the first question.
ex.zh: 面试官问出第一个问题时，我的脑子一片空白。

senses: v. (以厚层)覆盖,笼罩；adj. 全面的,包含所有的,适用于所有情形的
blanket.usage: 辨析:blanket铺于床上使人暖和的覆盖物;carpet地毯(铺满整个房间);rug小地毯(多铺在桌下或暖炉前)

ex.en: Thick snow lay like a blanket over the fields, insulating the winter wheat against the frost.
ex.zh: 厚厚的积雪像毯子一样覆盖着田野，为冬小麦抵御霜冻。

senses: n. (管乐器等的)吹奏,突然发出的响声
n./vt. 爆炸,爆破;炸掉;猛烈抨击
n. 爆炸；一阵（风），一股（气流）
blast.usage: 同义:gust;explosion,blow out,burst;派生blasted枯萎的,遭破坏的；b（不）+last（持续）→爆炸一般是瞬间的，不持续→爆炸

ex.en: A blast of hot air came from the furnace.
ex.zh: 一股热风从火炉里吹了出来。

ex.en: The blast shattered windows in buildings several streets away.
ex.zh: 爆炸震碎了几条街外建筑物的窗户。

ex.en: A blast of cold air rushed in when the door opened.
ex.zh: 门一开，一股冷空气扑面而来。

senses: n. [C] 烈火；火灾 [sing.] 火焰
n. 火焰,烈火;强烈(或眩目)的光
v. 熊熊燃烧,冒火焰;发(强)光;宣传,传播;迸发,爆发

ex.en: The fire blazed through the old warehouse within minutes.
ex.zh: 大火几分钟内就在旧仓库中熊熊燃烧起来。

ex.en: Firefighters battled the blaze for more than six hours.
ex.zh: 消防员与这场大火搏斗了六个多小时。

ex.en: The garden blazed with colour in early summer.
ex.zh: 初夏时节，花园色彩绚烂。

senses: adj. 不乐观的，无望的，暗淡的；无遮掩的
荒凉的；索然无味的；阴冷的
adj. 不乐观的，暗淡的；阴冷的；荒凉的
bleak.usage: 派生bleakly荒凉地；房子一直漏水（leak），屋里非常阴冷（bleak）。；索引p403

ex.en: David Graddol concludes that monoglot English graduates face a bleak economic future.
ex.zh: 戴维·葛拉多尔的结论是，只会一门语言的英国本科毕业生面临惨淡的经济前景。

ex.en: The report paints a bleak picture of the region's economic future.
ex.zh: 该报告描绘了该地区经济前景黯淡的图景。

ex.en: They struggled to farm the bleak, windswept hills.
ex.zh: 他们在荒凉多风的山丘上艰难耕作。

ex.en: If the wound continues to bleed after ten minutes of pressure, seek medical attention immediately.
ex.zh: 如果按压十分钟后伤口仍继续流血，请立即就医。

ex.en: The novelist's distinctive style is a blend of sharp humour and deep sympathy for ordinary people.
ex.zh: 这位小说家独特的风格是犀利幽默与对普通人深切同情的融合。

senses: vt. 求上帝降福于；祝福
bless.usage: [族] blessing n. 祝福；幸事；派生blessed adj.有福的；blessing n.祝福；好事

ex.en: We're blessed with five lovely grandchildren.
ex.zh: 我们很有福气，有五个可爱的孙子孙女。

ex.en: The priest blessed the newly opened community centre.
ex.zh: 牧师为新建成的社区中心祈福。

ex.en: We are blessed with mild weather for most of the year.
ex.zh: 我们这里一年中大部分时间都有宜人的天气。

senses: adj. 有福的，愉快安宁的；无忧无虑的
n. 幸事;赞同,支持;祈福,祈祷

ex.en: The Internet affords anonymity to its users, a blessing to privacy and freedom of speech.
ex.zh: 互联网为用户提供了匿名保护，这便于用户保护隐私权和言论自由。

ex.en: Losing that job proved a blessing in disguise.
ex.zh: 失去那份工作原来是因祸得福。

ex.en: The parents gave their blessing to the young couple's marriage.
ex.zh: 父母同意了这对年轻夫妇的婚事。

senses: n. 有害的事物，不利因素
blight.usage: b(发音似"不"即"没有")+light(光)→没有光，生物生长受到"损害"

ex.en: His career has been blighted by injures.
ex.zh: 他的事业不断受到伤病的困扰。

blind.usage: 又:blind obedience盲目的顺从；adj.失明的，盲的；视而不见的 v.使变瞎；使眼花；使无辨别力

ex.en: The charity provides guide dogs free of charge to blind people.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构免费为盲人提供导盲犬。

ex.en: Blind loyalty to a leader can be dangerous.
ex.zh: 对领导者的盲目忠诚可能是危险的。

ex.en: Without data, the committee was blind to the true scale of the problem.
ex.zh: 没有数据，委员会对问题的真实规模视而不见。

senses: n. 大块木料(石料、金属)

ex.en: City planners want to block traffic from the historic centre to reduce pollution and noise.
ex.zh: 城市规划者希望阻止车辆进入历史中心区，以减少污染和噪声。

ex.en: Regular donors are urgently needed, as blood supplies typically fall to dangerous levels during holiday periods.
ex.zh: 目前急需定期献血者，因为假期期间血液库存通常会降至危险水平。

senses: n. 体内循环的血液;血流

bloody.usage: 助记:blood(血)+y(形容词后缀)→流血的,血腥的；索引p403

ex.en: The country suffered a bloody civil war that lasted a decade.
ex.zh: 这个国家经历了一场持续十年的血腥内战。

ex.en: The film was criticized for its bloody scenes of violence.
ex.zh: 这部电影因血腥的暴力场面而受到批评。

ex.en: Historical records describe the bloody suppression of the uprising.
ex.zh: 历史记载描述了对起义的血腥镇压。

senses: vi. 开花;变得健康(或快活、自信);繁荣,兴盛
bloom.usage: 这个地方花(bloom)的数量激增(boom)

ex.en: Cherry trees bloom earlier each year, a shift scientists link directly to rising winter temperatures.
ex.zh: 樱花树每年开花都更早，科学家将这一变化直接与冬季气温上升联系起来。

blossom.usage: 辨析:blossom指能结果的树或灌木开的花;bloom指不结果实供观赏的花,借喻指全盛时期；索引p403

ex.en: The cherry trees blossom in early April, drawing crowds to the park.
ex.zh: 樱花树四月初开花，吸引大批游人来到公园。

ex.en: Her small business blossomed into a national chain within five years.
ex.zh: 她的小生意在五年内发展成了全国连锁。

ex.en: Scholars argue that friendship blossoms only when people spend time together face to face.
ex.zh: 学者们认为，只有面对面共处时友谊才会开花结果。

ex.en: She wore a plain white blouse to the interview, believing that simple clothes convey professionalism.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件素白的女式衬衫去面试，相信简洁的着装能体现职业素养。

blow.usage: blow one's own trumpet(horn)自吹自擂

ex.en: Losing the contract was a serious blow to the firm, which had planned to expand its workforce.
ex.zh: 失去这份合同对公司是一个沉重打击，该公司原本计划扩大员工规模。

senses: adj. 伤心的,沮丧的,忧郁的

ex.en: The study found that rooms painted soft blue made employees feel calmer and more focused.
ex.zh: 研究发现，涂成淡蓝色的房间让员工感到更平静、更专注。

phrases.p: a blueprint for new operational guidelines

blueprint.usage: 助记:blue(蓝色)+print(图案)→蓝图；索引p403

ex.en: The government has unveiled a blueprint for reforming the national health service over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府公布了一份在未来十年改革国民医疗服务体系的蓝图。

senses: vi. (因无知、粗心等而)犯大错
n. 愚蠢（或粗心）的错误
v. 犯愚蠢（或粗心）的错误
blunder.usage: 辨析:blunder较严重愚蠢的错误;mistake粗心或知识不足导致,一般用词;error含行为道德过失;slip小错;派生blunderer犯粗心错误的人；发音类似“不拦的”→现在不拦住他，以后他会酿成大错的→犯愚蠢（或粗心）的错误；索引p403

ex.en: She cast a sidelong glance at Eric to see if he had noticed her blunder.
ex.zh: 她斜眼看了埃里克一眼，看他有没有留意到她的错误。

ex.en: Sending the confidential file to the wrong client was a costly blunder.
ex.zh: 把机密文件误发给错误的客户是一个代价高昂的大错。

ex.en: The government blundered by announcing the tax before consulting retailers.
ex.zh: 政府未与零售商协商便宣布征税，犯了大错。

ex.en: A single navigational blunder sent the ship miles off course.
ex.zh: 一次导航上的重大失误使船偏离航线数英里。

senses: vt. 使减弱；使（尖端、刃）变钝
adj. 率直的,直言不讳的
blunt.usage: 同义dull;frank,outspoken,straightforward;反义sharp；发音类似“不烂它”→拿刀切肉，剁了半天也没有剁烂，刀子是“钝的”；索引p403

ex.en: It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalization.
ex.zh: 这是一项雄心勃勃的尝试，旨在钝化全球化最尖锐的棱角。

ex.en: To put it bluntly, the project has failed and the funding must stop.
ex.zh: 直截了当地说，项目失败了，资助必须停止。

ex.en: A blunt knife is far more dangerous than a sharp one.
ex.zh: 钝刀比锋利的刀危险得多。

ex.en: Her blunt criticism of the new rules annoyed several senior colleagues.
ex.zh: 她对新规则直言不讳的批评惹恼了几位资深同事。

senses: n. （移动的）模糊形状；模糊的记忆
blur.usage: 发音类似"不乐"：老人不快乐因为年龄大了看东西模糊；索引p403

ex.en: With the blurring of roles, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
ex.zh: 由于角色界限的模糊，女性在家中感到压力更大也就不足为奇了。

ex.en: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
ex.zh: 由于角色定位的模糊，以及职业女性在家时比在上班时更难调整自己，女性在家中有压力就不足为奇了。

ex.en: Tears blurred her vision as she read the old letter.
ex.zh: 读旧信时泪水模糊了她的视线。

ex.en: The boundary between work and leisure has become increasingly blurred.
ex.zh: 工作与休闲的界限日益模糊。

senses: v. (因害羞、激动、窘困等)脸红
n.& v. 脸红；羞愧，尴尬
blush.usage: spare sb.'s blushes不让某人受窘

ex.en: He blushed visibly when the audience began to applaud his unexpected speech at the awards ceremony.
ex.zh: 当观众为他在颁奖典礼上的意外发言鼓掌时，他的脸明显红了。

phrases.m: 美国财务会计标准委员会

board.usage: 结合熟悉的 blackboard（黑板）来记忆，black 是“黑”，board 就是“板”。；索引p403

ex.en: She pays $100 a week board and lodging.
ex.zh: 她每周支付100美元的食宿费。

ex.en: The board meets quarterly to review the company's long-term strategy.
ex.zh: 董事会每季度开会审议公司长期战略。

ex.en: Passengers began boarding the ferry an hour before departure.
ex.zh: 乘客在开船前一小时开始登船。

ex.en: She pinned the exam timetable to the notice board outside the hall.
ex.zh: 她把考试时间表钉在大厅外的布告板上。

senses: n. ①自吹自擂，自夸的话
②引以自豪的事物(或原因)
v. ①(of, about) 自吹自擂，夸耀，吹嘘；②以拥有……而自豪；③有，包含
v. 自夸，吹嘘，夸耀，炫耀
boast.usage: 辨析：boast 自夸、以有……自豪，指得意地显示成功；brag 吹嘘、自夸，暗含虚张声势与傲慢；派生 boastful adj. 自吹自擂的；v.吹嘘，夸耀 n.夸耀，自吹自擂；索引p403

ex.en: The small coastal town boasts two excellent museums and a theatre dating from the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 这座海滨小镇拥有两座出色的博物馆和一座始建于十九世纪的剧院。

ex.en: He is always boasting about his son's academic achievements, which greatly annoys his colleagues.
ex.zh: 他总是夸耀儿子的学业成绩，这让同事们非常反感。

ex.en: The airline boasts that its new fleet cuts fuel consumption by a quarter compared with older aircraft.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司夸口说，与旧机型相比，其新机队可将燃油消耗减少四分之一。

ex.en: The fishermen rowed their small boat across the bay before dawn to reach the best fishing grounds.
ex.zh: 渔民们天亮前划着小船穿过海湾，到达最佳的捕鱼区域。

senses: adv. 移动全身地;用力地;整个地,完全地
n.(pl. bodies) 身体,躯体,躯干

phrases.m: 全身心地,竭尽全力,全心全意

ex.en: Regular exercise helps the body fight infection and can reduce the risk of chronic disease.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼有助于身体抵御感染，并能降低患慢性病的风险。

ex.en: Water should be boiled for at least one minute before drinking in areas where supplies are unsafe.
ex.zh: 在供水不安全的地区，饮用水至少应煮沸一分钟。

senses: adj. 大胆自信的；敢于表白情感的；敢于冒险的

phrases.m: 极其胆大妄为,极为唐突放肆

bold.usage: 同义brave,courageous,rude;反义timid adj.胆怯的；虽然他有点老了（old），但他依然敢于冒险（bold）。

ex.en: If we were really bold, we might even begin to think of high-calorie fast food in the same way as cigarettes.
ex.zh: 如果我们真的大胆，我们甚至可以开始像对待烟草一样对待高热量快餐。

ex.en: The government made a bold decision to cut taxes despite fierce opposition.
ex.zh: 政府不顾激烈反对，做出了减税的大胆决定。

ex.en: The warning was printed in bold letters so that no reader could miss it.
ex.zh: 警告用黑体字印刷，任何读者都不会错过。

ex.en: Critics praised the young director's boldness in reinterpreting a classic play for a modern audience.
ex.zh: 评论家称赞这位年轻导演为现代观众重新诠释经典剧目的大胆之举。

ex.en: The central bank cut interest rates to bolster the struggling economy.
ex.zh: 央行降息以提振陷入困境的经济。

ex.en: New evidence bolstered the scientist's argument about climate change.
ex.zh: 新证据增强了这位科学家关于气候变化的论点。

ex.en: Volunteers were recruited to bolster the hospital's exhausted nursing staff.
ex.zh: 招募志愿者是为了支援医院疲惫不堪的护理人员。

ex.en: Engineers discovered that a single loose bolt had caused the bridge section to shift in high winds.
ex.zh: 工程师们发现，仅一颗松动的螺栓就导致桥梁的一段在大风中移位。

senses: n. 炸弹（the bomb）[sing.] 核弹

ex.en: The museum was evacuated after staff reported an unattended bag, though no bomb was found.
ex.zh: 工作人员报告发现一个无人看管的包后，博物馆进行了疏散，但并未发现炸弹。

senses: n. 空话,大话;大放厥词
n. 结合(物),黏结(剂),联结

phrases.m: 未能和某人建立亲密关系

bond.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“捆绑”→把两人捆绑到一起→使建立亲密关系；发音类似“绑的”→绑在一起的，就是有“联系”的→联系，关系。；索引p404

ex.en: It will help strengthen their emotional bonds.
ex.zh: 这将有助于加强他们的情感纽带。

ex.en: They may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviours like communal exploring and playing.
ex.zh: 它们（指老鼠）可能已经与社交机器鼠建立了更亲密的关系，因为社交机器鼠表现出了诸如集体探索和玩耍的行为。

ex.en: The disaster created a strong bond between the two neighbouring villages.
ex.zh: 这场灾难使两个相邻村庄之间结成了牢固的纽带。

ex.en: Many investors buy government bonds as a safe way to store wealth.
ex.zh: 许多投资者购买政府债券作为储值的安全方式。

ex.en: Doctors recommend weight-bearing exercise to keep bones strong and reduce the risk of fractures in old age.
ex.zh: 医生建议进行负重锻炼以保持骨骼强壮，降低老年骨折的风险。

bonus.usage: bo(联想成60)+nus(联想成nuts“坚果”)→年底公司发60袋坚果作为奖励→奖金；索引p404

ex.en: Staff receive a bonus if the company meets its annual targets.
ex.zh: 如果公司达到年度目标，员工可得到奖金。

ex.en: The mild October weather was an unexpected bonus for the tourism industry.
ex.zh: 十月温和的天气对旅游业来说是意外之喜。

ex.en: Several banks now pay part of executives' bonuses in company shares.
ex.zh: 如今几家银行以公司股票支付高管的部分奖金。

ex.en: Passengers are advised to book their tickets well in advance during the busy summer season.
ex.zh: 建议乘客在繁忙的夏季提前很久预订车票。

senses: n. 繁荣；（人口等的）激增
boom.usage: [反] bust n. 萧条；崩溃；同义 prosperity；同义 flourish, thrive；派生 booming adj. 兴旺发达的，迅速发展的；n.繁荣；隆隆声 v.迅速发展，繁荣；轰鸣， 轰响；老板们都希望公司繁荣(boom)，不希望公司遭遇厄运(doom)；baby boom 婴儿潮；索引p404

ex.en: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
ex.zh: 然而，如果认为我们现在只是经历着繁荣和萧条周期所带来的痛苦的一面，那就大错特错了。

ex.en: The baby boom after the war created huge demand for schools, housing and medical services.
ex.zh: 战后的婴儿潮给学校、住房和医疗服务带来了巨大需求。

ex.en: Cheap credit fueled a construction boom that transformed the skyline of many second-tier cities.
ex.zh: 低息信贷助推了建筑业的繁荣，改变了许多二线城市的天际线。

phrases.p: bring a boost in mood and feelings of belonging
phrases.m: 改善心情并提升归属感

boost.usage: boo(联想600)+st(联想street街道)→政府新修600条路“促进”当地经济增长；② n. 增长（2021年阅读）③ n. 增强；索引p404

ex.en: Automation should eventually boost productivity.
ex.zh: 自动化最终应该提高生产力。

ex.en: A move back to self-sufficiency, the argument goes, would boost the farming industry, political sovereignty and even the nation's health.
ex.zh: 有说法认为，恢复自给自足将会促进农业发展，增强政治主权，甚至会促进国民健康。

ex.en: The government hopes the new railway will boost trade between the coastal and inland regions.
ex.zh: 政府希望这条新铁路能促进沿海与内陆地区之间的贸易。

senses: n. 靴子(常用pl.);(汽车后部的)行李箱
n. (用作附带评述)而且,另外,加之
boot.usage: 另:boot ball踢球;boot out赶走,开除；助记:用boot(猛踢)我的booth(货摊)；n.靴子；猛踢；(汽车的)后备箱 v.猛踢；锁住；启动；索引p404

ex.en: He pulled on his boots and set off across the frozen field.
ex.zh: 他穿上靴子，出发穿过冰封的田野。

ex.en: The spare wheel and the tool kit are kept in the boot.
ex.zh: 备用轮胎和工具箱放在后备箱里。

ex.en: She wiped the mud from her boots before entering the farmhouse.
ex.zh: 进农舍前她把靴子上的泥擦掉。

senses: n. 货摊;小隔间,电话亭,投票间,(餐馆中的)火车座,卡座

ex.en: Visitors crowded around the company's booth at the technology fair to test its newest device.
ex.zh: 在科技博览会上，参观者围在那家公司的展位旁，试用其最新设备。

ex.en: Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them.
ex.zh: 有些权力确实专属于联邦政府，对公民身份及边界的控制便在其中。

ex.en: France borders Germany.
ex.zh: 法国与德国毗邻。

ex.en: The town lies right on the border between the two countries.
ex.zh: 这座小镇恰好在两国边界上。

ex.en: The garden borders the river, so every window has a water view.
ex.zh: 花园与河相接，所以每扇窗都能看到水景。

senses: v. ①使厌烦，使厌倦；②钻孔，挖(通道)
n. ①令人讨厌的人(或事)，麻烦
②(管道、枪管等的)内径，口径
n. 令人讨厌的人或事
bore.usage: 同义 drill, pierce；派生 bored adj. 厌倦的，烦闷的；boring adj. 无聊的，厌烦的；b（饱）or（或者）e（饿）都让人厌烦→使厌烦；令人讨厌的人或事。

ex.en: I won't bore you with too many details.
ex.zh: 我不会拿太多细节来烦你。

ex.en: The professor's lengthy lecture bored most of the students into silence.
ex.zh: 教授冗长的讲座使大多数学生听得厌烦、默不作声。

ex.en: Workers bored a tunnel through the mountain to shorten the railway line.
ex.zh: 工人们在山体中钻凿隧道以缩短铁路线。

senses: adj. 无聊的，无趣的；厌倦的

ex.en: Students become bored when lessons lack variety, so teachers are encouraged to mix lectures with discussion.
ex.zh: 课堂缺乏变化时学生会感到厌倦，因此鼓励教师将讲授与讨论相结合。

ex.en: Reviewers dismissed the film as boring and predictable, despite its impressive special effects.
ex.zh: 尽管特效出色，评论家仍认为这部电影乏味且毫无新意。

senses: adj. 出身于……的，天生的，生来的
born.usage: adj.天生的，生来就有的；出 生的 v.忍受（bear 的过去分词形式） 出生

ex.en: She was born in a small village but rose to lead a global company.
ex.zh: 她出生在小村庄，却成长为一家全球公司的领导者。

ex.en: Many researchers believe that some people are born with a talent for languages.
ex.zh: 许多研究者认为有些人生来就具备语言天赋。

ex.en: A new political movement was born out of widespread dissatisfaction with the old order.
ex.zh: 一场新的政治运动因人们对旧秩序的普遍不满而诞生。

ex.en: Many small businesses borrow money to survive the slow winter months, repaying it once sales recover.
ex.zh: 许多小企业靠借款熬过销售缓慢的冬季，待销售回升后再偿还。

senses: v. 指挥,支配,发号施令
boss.usage: 派生bossy adj.霸道的,专横的

ex.en: A good boss listens to employees' concerns before making decisions that affect the whole team.
ex.zh: 好的老板会在做出影响整个团队的决定之前倾听员工的顾虑。

ex.en: Both candidates promised to cut taxes, though they disagreed sharply on how to fund public services.
ex.zh: 两位候选人都承诺减税，但在如何为公共服务筹资的问题上分歧严重。

bother.usage: 辨析：bother 指不停地扰乱、麻烦，使人不能安宁；annoy 指因干扰、不顺利等而烦恼、懊恼；irritate 恼怒、不耐烦，比 annoy 更强烈，指暂时或短期的恼怒；我工作的时候，不允许我弟弟（brother）来打扰（bother）我。

ex.en: This brain drain has long bothered policymakers in poor countries.
ex.zh: 长期以来，这种人才流失一直困扰着贫穷国家的政策制定者。

ex.en: He did not bother to read the contract carefully before signing it.
ex.zh: 他签署合同前都懒得仔细阅读。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a constant bother for commuters in big cities.
ex.zh: 拥堵的交通是大城市通勤者的持续困扰。

ex.en: The cafe now charges a small deposit on each bottle, which customers reclaim when they return it.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆现在对每个瓶子收取少量押金，顾客归还瓶子时可以取回。

phrases.p: be at the bottom of sth.

bottom.usage: 另:Bottoms up!干杯!from the bottom of one's heart从心里,诚恳地

ex.en: Sediment collected at the bottom of the lake reveals centuries of information about the local climate.
ex.zh: 湖底沉积的泥沙保存着数百年来的当地气候信息。

ex.en: Small firms often bounce back quickly from recessions if they keep their costs under control.
ex.zh: 如果能控制好成本，小公司往往能在经济衰退后迅速恢复。

phrases.m: 热衷于,忙于;与……有密切关系

bound.usage: 助记:abound(丰富)的思想都是bound(跳跃)的；发音类似“蹦跶”→可以蹦跶但不能超越忍耐的限度→要自由但要在一定范围内→跳跃；受约束。

ex.en: You are bound by the contract to pay before the end of the month.
ex.zh: 按照合同规定，你必须在月底前付款。

ex.en: With such strong demand, house prices are bound to keep rising.
ex.zh: 需求如此旺盛，房价必定会持续上涨。

ex.en: Scientists once believed that medical research was bound by the limits of technology.
ex.zh: 科学家一度认为医学研究受制于技术的局限。

boundary.usage: 助记:bound(受约束的)+ary(名词后缀)→边界;辨析:boundary着重指自然形成的天然分界线,多指正式划定的领土分界线;border指两国或两地分界处附近的边缘地区即边境地区;frontier指属于本国一侧的边缘地；n.分界线，边界；bound(界限)+ary(场所，地点)→场所的界限→分界线；索引p404

ex.en: The river is the boundary between the two countries.
ex.zh: 这条河是两国的分界线。

ex.en: Disputes arose when the survey showed that the new wall crossed the boundary of the neighboring farm.
ex.zh: 测量显示新墙越过了邻近农场的边界，争议随之产生。

ex.en: The internet has blurred the boundary between work and private life for many office employees.
ex.zh: 对许多上班族来说，互联网已经模糊了工作与私人生活之间的界限。

senses: adj. 中产阶级的;追求物质享受的,平庸粗俗的;资产阶级的

ex.en: The cellist bowed deeply to the audience before lifting her instrument to begin the final piece.
ex.zh: 大提琴手向观众深深鞠躬，然后举起乐器开始演奏最后一首曲目。

senses: n. (某处的)最深的或最靠里面的部分

ex.en: Nutritionists suggest filling half your bowl with vegetables before adding rice or meat.
ex.zh: 营养学家建议先在碗里盛一半蔬菜，再加入米饭或肉类。

ex.en: Each product ships in a sturdy cardboard box designed to be reused rather than discarded.
ex.zh: 每件产品都装在一个坚固的纸盒中运输，这种盒子设计为可重复使用而非丢弃。

senses: n. 年少的儿子；男孩；男青年；伙计

ex.en: The boy who repaired bicycles in his spare time later founded one of the country's largest cycling companies.
ex.zh: 那个业余时间修理自行车的男孩后来创办了该国最大的自行车公司之一。

senses: v. (联合起来)抵制,拒绝参加
v. 抵制，拒绝参加（或购买、使用）
boycott.usage: boycott 抵制（贸易/活动）；源自人名 Boycott。；文化站: 源自英国地主Charles Boycott，因激起公愤遭联合抵制，其姓氏遂成"联合抵制"代称；索引p404

ex.en: Motorists boycotted the company's gas stations and its share price crashed.
ex.zh: 驾车者抵制该公司的加油站，其股价暴跌。

ex.en: Consumers boycotted the company's products.
ex.zh: 消费者抵制该公司的产品。

ex.en: Consumers threatened to boycott the airline unless it dropped the fuel surcharge.
ex.zh: 消费者威胁抵制这家航空公司，除非它取消燃油附加费。

ex.en: The main opposition parties called for a boycott of the election.
ex.zh: 主要反对党呼吁抵制这次选举。

senses: ②使防备，使做好准备 ③做好防备
brace.usage: 反义 loosen v. 解开，松开；派生 bracing adj. 令人振奋的，给人活力的

bracket.usage: 助记:去掉bracket前的b就是racket(球拍)

senses: n. 脑；智力；脑力；逻辑思维能力
brain.usage: 另 brain trust 智囊团；beat one's brains 费劲思考；brain work 脑力劳动

ex.en: For consciousness to evolve, a brain with a threshold level of complexity and capacity is required.
ex.zh: 为了让意识进化，需要一个在复杂性和容量上达到阈值水平的大脑。

ex.en: Investigators concluded that the driver had failed to brake in time on the wet road.
ex.zh: 调查人员断定，司机未能在湿滑路面上及时刹车。

phrases.m: 扩大业务范围(或研究领域等)

ex.en: The bank plans to close twenty rural branches and replace them with mobile banking services.
ex.zh: 该银行计划关闭二十家乡村分行，代之以移动银行服务。

ex.en: Summer homes, European travel, BMWs—the locations, place names and name brands may change, but such items do not seem less in demand today than a decade or two years ago.
ex.zh: 避暑别墅、欧洲旅行、宝马车——地点、地名和品牌可能会改变，但如今对这些东西的需求似乎并不比一二十年前少。

ex.en: The company spent millions on advertising to build a global brand.
ex.zh: 该公司斥巨资做广告以打造全球品牌。

ex.en: Farmers branded their cattle to mark them as private property.
ex.zh: 农场主给牛打上烙印，以标明其归私人所有。

senses: vt. 勇敢面对；经受（困难）

ex.en: It was brave of the junior clerk to question the accounting practices of her own department.
ex.zh: 这位初级职员敢于质疑本部门的会计操作，实属勇敢。

senses: n. 勇敢的行为(或态度)

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: v. (在防御工事等上)打开缺口;违反,违背
n. 违反(法规、协议、职责等)
n. 破坏,中断;裂口,缺口
breach.usage: violate 的近义词；breach 违约/违背；常指破坏协议、法律、信任。；索引p404

ex.en: Selling the data was a serious breach of trust.
ex.zh: 出售这些数据是严重的背信行为。

ex.en: The company was fined for a breach of safety regulations.
ex.zh: 该公司因违反安全法规而被罚款。

ex.en: The cyber attack caused a serious breach of millions of customers' personal data.
ex.zh: 这次网络攻击导致数百万客户的个人数据遭到严重泄露。

ex.en: The bakery donates unsold bread to local charities at the end of each day.
ex.zh: 这家面包店每天营业结束时把未售出的面包捐赠给当地慈善机构。

senses: n. [U,C] 宽度；（知识、兴趣等）广泛
n. 宽度;幅度;广度;广泛性

ex.en: Examiners praised the essay for the breadth of its reading, though its argument lacked depth.
ex.zh: 评阅人称赞这篇文章阅读面广，但其论证缺乏深度。

senses: vt.&vi. （使）破，裂，碎；弄坏；损坏；坏掉
break.usage: break in强行进入,闯入/打断插嘴;break off断绝,结束;break into闯入;break through突破;break up中止,结束；①vt.违反(2017年阅读) ②vi.分解(2016年阅读):Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and

ex.en: An official act is deemed corruptive only if it involves breaking contracts officially.
ex.zh: 只有涉及正式违约的官方行为才被视为腐败行为。

ex.en: Talks nearly broke down after both sides refused to compromise on tariffs.
ex.zh: 双方拒绝在关税问题上妥协后，谈判几近破裂。

ex.en: Workers are entitled to a short break between shifts under the new labour law.
ex.zh: 根据新劳动法，工人有权在班次之间享受短暂休息。

senses: n. [C,U]（体系的）崩溃；（关系的）破裂
n. [C] 精神崩溃；神经衰弱
n. 破裂，失败；损坏，故障

phrases.m: 在高速公路上出的故障

breakdown.usage: [记] break（背弃）+down（往下）→关系无法往下维持→破裂。[近] fault n. 故障

ex.en: The breakdown of the negotiations was not unexpected.
ex.zh: 谈判的失败是预料之中的事。

ex.en: A breakdown in communication between departments delayed the project for months.
ex.zh: 部门之间沟通的失灵使项目延误了数月。

ex.en: The report gives a detailed breakdown of how the funds were spent.
ex.zh: 该报告详细列出了资金的用途明细。

ex.en: Research shows that children who eat breakfast concentrate better in morning classes than those who skip it.
ex.zh: 研究表明，吃早餐的孩子在上午的课堂上比不吃早餐的孩子更专注。

senses: n. 突破性进展,重要的新发现
breakthrough.usage: 组合词:break(打破)+through(穿过)→突破；索引p404

ex.en: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
ex.zh: 今年设立的生命科学突破奖对"生命科学"所应包含的内容就持有很不具代表性的看法。

ex.en: Scientists announced a major breakthrough in the treatment of the disease.
ex.zh: 科学家宣布在该病的治疗上取得重大突破。

ex.en: The peace talks finally achieved a breakthrough after two years of deadlock.
ex.zh: 经过两年僵局，和谈终于取得了突破。

ex.en: Her breakthrough came when a leading journal published her first paper.
ex.zh: 一家顶级期刊发表她的第一篇论文后，她迎来了转机。

phrases.m: 捶胸顿足(可能只是做给别人看的)

breast.usage: 辨析:breast指前胸,尤指女性乳房;bosom指整个胸部,亦表内心、心绪;bust多指妇女的胸脯;chest泛指人或动物的胸或胸腔

ex.en: The robin puffed out its red breast to warn rivals away from its territory.
ex.zh: 知更鸟鼓起红色的胸脯，警告对手远离它的领地。

breath.usage: 词组catch one's breath歇口气;hold one's breath屏住呼吸;under one's breath低声地

ex.en: The diver paused to catch his breath before descending to inspect the coral reef below.
ex.zh: 潜水员停下来喘口气，然后下潜去检查下方的珊瑚礁。

ex.en: Doctors taught the patient to breathe slowly in order to reduce anxiety.
ex.zh: 医生教病人缓慢呼吸以减轻焦虑。

ex.en: The audience could hardly breathe during the final minutes of the match.
ex.zh: 比赛最后几分钟，观众紧张得几乎屏住了呼吸。

ex.en: The new policy gives struggling firms room to breathe before stricter rules take effect.
ex.zh: 新政策为陷入困境的企业在更严格的规定生效前留出了喘息空间。

phrases.p: bred and born / born and bred

breed.usage: 发音类似哺育的→饲养，培育；索引p404

ex.en: He represents a new breed of politician.
ex.zh: 他代表着新一类的政治家。

ex.en: Mosquitoes breed rapidly in warm, stagnant water.
ex.zh: 蚊子在温暖死水中迅速繁殖。

ex.en: Farmers in the valley breed cattle for both meat and milk.
ex.zh: 山谷里的农民饲养的牛既供肉用也供奶用。

ex.en: This rare breed of sheep is well adapted to the harsh mountain climate.
ex.zh: 这种稀有的绵羊品种非常适应恶劣的高山气候。

senses: n. 微风，轻风；轻而易举的事
breeze.usage: 辨析:breeze微风、和风;gale大风、突发的一阵风,常有破坏性;wind泛指空气流动产生的风,一般用语;派生breezy adj.微风轻拂的,轻松的；微风（breeze）吹拂，我感觉有点冷，打了个喷嚏（sneeze）。

ex.en: The flowers were gently swaying in the breeze.
ex.zh: 花儿在微风中轻轻舞动。

ex.en: A cool breeze from the sea made the summer evening pleasant.
ex.zh: 海上吹来的凉风使夏日的夜晚十分惬意。

ex.en: For an experienced programmer, fixing this error is a breeze.
ex.zh: 对经验丰富的程序员来说，修正这个错误轻而易举。

bribe.usage: [族]bribery n. 贿赂行为；派生bribery n.行贿,受贿；bri（=bring带来）+be（发音类似“币”，钱币）→带钱币来→带着钱币、宝贝可以“贿赂”伴娘，让她们放心地把新娘交给你→贿赂；索引p404

ex.en: It was alleged that he had taken bribes while in office.
ex.zh: 他被指控在任时收受贿赂。

ex.en: The official was accused of accepting bribes from construction firms in return for planning permission.
ex.zh: 这名官员被指控收受建筑公司的贿赂，以换取规划许可。

ex.en: He tried to bribe the guard with expensive cigarettes, but the gate remained firmly closed.
ex.zh: 他试图用昂贵的香烟贿赂门卫，但大门依然紧闭。

ex.en: Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery.
ex.zh: 民选领袖应该获准帮助支持者解决一些涉及官方的问题，而不必担心会遭到贿赂起诉。

ex.en: Volunteers made bricks from local clay to rebuild the school destroyed by the earthquake.
ex.zh: 志愿者用当地黏土制砖，重建被地震摧毁的学校。

ex.en: According to local custom, the bride wears red, a colour believed to bring good fortune.
ex.zh: 按照当地习俗，新娘要穿红色，这种颜色被认为能带来好运。

ex.en: The new bridge cuts the journey between the two cities from four hours to under one.
ex.zh: 新大桥把两座城市之间的车程从四小时缩短到不到一小时。

senses: adj. 短时间的，短暂的；简短的，简洁的

phrases.m: 使简短，把……快快做完(或对付过去)

brief.usage: 辨析：to be brief 简而言之，扼要地说；in short/in a word 简单地说，但其前不加 to be；索引p404

ex.en: The chairman delivered a brief speech before the award ceremony began.
ex.zh: 颁奖典礼开始前，主席发表了简短的讲话。

ex.en: After a brief pause, the witness continued her account of the accident.
ex.zh: 短暂停顿之后，证人继续讲述事故的经过。

ex.en: Lawyers filed a legal brief arguing that the new rule was unconstitutional.
ex.zh: 律师提交了一份法律摘要，主张新规定违宪。

ex.en: The lawyer arrived with a thick briefcase full of documents for the afternoon hearing.
ex.zh: 律师带着一只装满下午听证会文件的厚重公文包到场。

senses: a. 明亮的；聪明的；鲜艳的
adj. 发光的,反光的,明亮的
adj. 鲜明的,晴朗的;愉快的,高兴的,美好的
bright.usage: 派生brighten v.(使)更明亮;(使)快活起来;(使)增添乐趣,有希望

ex.en: Her bright students quickly mastered the new software and began teaching it to their classmates.
ex.zh: 她那些聪明的学生很快掌握了新软件，并开始教给同学们。

senses: a. 明亮的；才华横溢的
adj. 巧妙的；使人印象深刻的；很好的，杰出的
brilliant.usage: 助记:brill(emit发出)+i+ant(形容词后缀)→能发出光的→光辉的；brilli（发光）+ant（后缀）→发光的→明亮的，灿烂的；杰出的。

ex.en: He is a brilliant young man.
ex.zh: 他是个才华横溢的年轻人。

ex.en: The team came up with a brilliant solution to the energy crisis.
ex.zh: 该团队想出了一个解决能源危机的绝妙方案。

ex.en: Sunlight reflected off the brilliant white walls of the ancient city.
ex.zh: 阳光反射在古城雪白发亮的城墙上。

senses: vt. 带……到某处；带来；导致

phrases.m: 使出现,使明显;公布,出版

bring.usage: 词组bring forth产生,提出;bring forward提出;bring about引起,造成;辨析:bring朝说话人方向移动;carry随身带着,无方向性;fetch去了以后带回某物

ex.en: Online shopping has brought convenience to consumers but placed enormous pressure on delivery workers.
ex.zh: 网购给消费者带来了便利，却给送货工人造成了巨大压力。

senses: adj. ①兴隆的，繁忙活跃的
brisk.usage: 反义 slack adj. 懒散的

ex.en: Shopkeepers reported brisk trade in the week before the festival, with sales up by a fifth.
ex.zh: 店主们反映节前一周生意兴隆，销售额增长了五分之一。

broad.usage: 辨析：与 wide 均指宽；broad 指表面宽广，肩背胸宽只用 broad；口径缝隙用 wide；索引p404

ex.en: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
ex.zh: 如今消费者处理做出购买决策这一过程的处理方式，意味着市场营销的影响力来自传统付费媒体以外的广泛因素。

ex.en: The new curriculum has won broad support from teachers and parents.
ex.zh: 新课程赢得了教师和家长的广泛支持。

ex.en: The river is nearly a mile broad where it reaches the sea.
ex.zh: 这条河在入海处宽近一英里。

ex.en: He is a scholar of broad experience in both education and banking.
ex.zh: 他是一位在教育界和银行业都有丰富经验的学者。

senses: n. 宽带;宽频带;宽波段

ex.en: Rural households without reliable broadband remain disadvantaged in accessing education and government services online.
ex.zh: 没有可靠宽带的农村家庭在在线获取教育和政务服务方面仍处于不利地位。

senses: v. 广播(节目)，播送，转播
broadcast.usage: v.散布，传播 n.电视节目，广播节目；索引p404

ex.en: The final match will be broadcast live on national television.
ex.zh: 决赛将在国家电视台现场直播。

ex.en: She hosts a weekly radio broadcast on science and public health.
ex.zh: 她主持一档每周播出的科学与公共卫生广播节目。

ex.en: The station broadcast a storm warning shortly before the hurricane struck.
ex.zh: 飓风来袭前片刻，电台播出了风暴警报。

ex.en: Studying abroad can broaden students' horizons and expose them to different academic traditions.
ex.zh: 出国留学可以开阔学生的视野，使他们接触不同的学术传统。

broadly.usage: adv.广泛地，普遍地；大 体上

ex.en: The holiday brochure promised unspoiled beaches, but visitors found them crowded with tourists.
ex.zh: 度假手册承诺那里有未遭破坏的海滩，但游客发现海滩上挤满了游人。
